instruction.K-674: Your teacher reads the words at the top. Draw your favorite in the big dotted box. Show who is with you, where you are, or what you do with it. Then write what you like best and why.
instruction.G2-568: Write an informative piece about the topic. Use the facts. Start with a topic sentence, tell facts with linking words, tell in your own words what one word means, and end with a closing sentence.
instruction.G2-559: Write an opinion piece about the question. Tell your opinion, give two or three reasons with linking words (because, and, also, another reason), and end with a closing sentence.
instruction.G3-569: Write a story about the idea. Introduce the characters, the setting, and the problem, tell the events in order with time words, show how a character feels with dialogue and an action, and write an ending that solves the problem and tells how a character feels.
instruction.K-019: Count along the strip. Write each missing number. (Build the part from K-020, a strip from 11 to 20.)
